cohort_rule: Select from existing owner-admitted instrument/provider scope. Empty means unresolved, not all assets.

lightgbm.note: Adapter maps objective per TargetSpec; quantile and ranking use VAN adapters, not unsupported Qlib loss values. Dataset suitability is checked, never silently changed.

neural.scaler_rule: Fit only permitted fold or context-local statistics; never final holdout. Persist exact transform.
neural.note: Shared values are provider-adapter configuration, not arguments blindly valid for every class. Each plugin has its own checked capabilities and valid loss/parameter mapping.

study.retention: Preserve every trial including pruned, rejected, failed and insufficient-data cases

retraining.cadence: Must be admitted per cohort/horizon after latency/drift study
retraining.model_expiry: Set independently of job cadence and enforce even if training is delayed

economic_policy.source: Reuse actual VAN validation policy plus preregistered task-specific statistical power, materiality and risk conditions

dependency_pins.note: Documentation version labels and historical stack-lock observed versions are not tested dependency locks.
